advancements.wangsword.root.title: The Redgold Age
advancements.wangsword.root.description: Smelt your first Redgold Ingot. Amethyst steel comes next, then End Alloy - this is where the line starts.
advancements.wangsword.redgold_gear.desc: Forge a full Redgold set - every later tier is smithed up from it.
The Redgold Necklace is the base for every functional necklace: Soulbearer, Huntsoul, Echo, Swiftedge, Protection, Magnet.
advancements.wangsword.redgold_ring.desc: A plain ring plus the right material gives a permanent effect. The Resistance ring also feeds the Protection Necklace.
advancements.wangsword.charm.title: Warding Charms
advancements.wangsword.charm.description: Carve a pattern into a blank charm and that damage type stops hurting you. Three charm slots.
advancements.wangsword.amethyst_star.des: Grind a Nether Star onto amethyst clusters - the ticket to the Amethyst line.
advancements.wangsword.amethyst_ingot.de: Redgold gear can now be smithed into Amethyst gear: Redgold piece + Amethyst Ingot in a smithing table.
advancements.wangsword.deep_debris.title: Deep Relic
advancements.wangsword.deep_debris.descr: Archean Debris hides deep underground; blast it for shards. Craft the Relic Seeker if you cannot find any.
advancements.wangsword.taigu_ingot.title: End Alloy
advancements.wangsword.taigu_ingot.descr: Shards, netherite scrap and an Amethyst Ingot melt into an End Alloy Ingot.
advancements.wangsword.taigu_armor.title: Alloy Shell
advancements.wangsword.taigu_armor.descr: Full set: Resistance III, no fall damage, creative flight, and one lethal hit is negated every 5 minutes.
advancements.wangsword.sword_tomb.title: Sword Tomb
advancements.wangsword.sword_tomb.descri: A cracked stone barrow out in the wild. Offer a diamond sword at the altar and the guardian wakes.
advancements.wangsword.guardian.title: Tomb Warden
advancements.wangsword.guardian.descript: An elite boss with 250 HP. Sword rings, flying blades, sweeps - do not stand in front of it.
advancements.wangsword.greatsword.title: Tomb Greatsword
advancements.wangsword.greatsword.descri: The guardian's blade. Combine two of the same tier to upgrade - enchantments and soul stacks carry over.
advancements.wangsword.greatsword_pro_ma: Push the greatsword to its fourth tier. Beyond that, only what the Warden left behind will do.
advancements.wangsword.oath.title: Tomb Oath
advancements.wangsword.oath.description: The tomb's final form. Raise it as a shield, hold it as a blade ring, plant it as a barrier.
advancements.wangsword.stone_bone.title: Sword in the Stone
advancements.wangsword.stone_bone.descri: The Warden falls and leaves a pedestal behind. Pull the blade out of the rock.
advancements.wangsword.molten_sealed.des: Fill every crack of the sealed blade with the colossus's molten core. It finally burns.
advancements.wangsword.sealed_rock.title: Sealed in Rock
advancements.wangsword.sealed_rock.descr: A Heart of the Earth and two crown shards reforge the stonebone. Only this blade bites the molten core.
advancements.wangsword.molten_breath.des: A still-warm breath lies in a chest at the molten altar in the Nether.
advancements.wangsword.cinder_colossus.d: Offer the breath to the summoner stone at the heart of the molten altar. The four-hundred-HP beast only respects the Sealed Rock Greatsword.
advancements.wangsword.molten_ingot.desc: A molten core wrapped in redgold, eight at a time. The main material for all four Caldera pieces.
advancements.wangsword.caldera_set.title: Molten Payload
advancements.wangsword.caldera_set.descr: Wear all four Caldera pieces: melee hits build Molten Charge, a full stack detonates, and the Set Skill key erupts a ring.
advancements.wangsword.caldera_crystal.d: A crystal from the Caldera Bats, half the time. Charges the Flame Staff's empowered shots, one charge per shot.
advancements.wangsword.ghost_ingot.title: Ghostguard Steel
advancements.wangsword.ghost_ingot.descr: Steel condensed from the guardian's remains. Three per kill, Looting gets you more.
advancements.wangsword.ghost_steel_set.d: Wear all four Ghostguard Steel pieces: +15% melee with a greatsword, immunity to burning, -25% boss damage, and five spectral blades on the Set Skill key.
advancements.wangsword.arsenal.title: Armoury
advancements.wangsword.arsenal.descripti: Ten weapons beyond Redgold, each with its own discipline. None of them sit on the smithing path - you have to find them yourself.
advancements.wangsword.witherspawn_kille: Double damage to withers and wither skeletons; right-click for a 16-block line slash with no cooldown. Withering cannot touch you.
advancements.wangsword.thunder_trident.d: Press X to call three lightning strikes and a deep whirlpool; everything inside is hit and thrown.
advancements.wangsword.meteor_bow.title: Meteor
advancements.wangsword.meteor_bow.descri: Hold the draw for three seconds and loose a piercing meteor for 30 damage. Even ordinary arrows call lightning on hit.
advancements.wangsword.crystal_hammer.de: Charge with right-click and slam: a ring shockwave from 3 to 6 blocks out. The centre takes double damage, plus slowness and weakness.
advancements.wangsword.swift_lance.title: Swift Lance
advancements.wangsword.swift_lance.descr: Hold right-click to charge forward; after 0.4s it hits along your line of sight for 1.6x. X is a long-range piercing charge.
advancements.wangsword.king_sword.title: King's Sword
advancements.wangsword.king_sword.descri: Left-click sword waves, right-click charge, Shift+right-click for the crimson arc, X for the charged finisher. Holding it grants Resistance, Strength, Regeneration and Night Vision.
Hold left-click for ten fully-drawn bolts a second - weightless, trailing fire. Right-click fires an explosive shell; X unleashes the breath.
advancements.wangsword.excalibur.title: Excalibur
advancements.wangsword.excalibur.descrip: Charge X for two seconds: a 64-block piercing beam for 150 damage. Right-click is the Wind King Hammer, holding a fan of targets aloft.
advancements.wangsword.avalon.title: Avalon
advancements.wangsword.avalon.descriptio: Sits in your inventory and heals, grants Resistance, and blocks poison and withering. Z opens five seconds of invulnerability on a 90s cooldown.
advancements.wangsword.death_scythe.desc: Heals 15% of damage dealt; right-click reaps a cone ahead, X trades health for damage. Heads it cuts always drop.
message.wangsword.guardian.enrage: The Sword Tomb Warden is enraged
tooltip.wangsword.molten_breath.desc: §7Right-click the Molten Core Summoner to offer it
